quest.title: If You Should Forget the Entrance to Dreams
quest.description: The Dough King and its kin have come to the little witches' secret base, and they even bring new clues with them...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x40, Pals Synergy x60, Mora x50000, Hero's Wit x5

chapter.title: If You Should Forget the Entrance to Dreams

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: The Dough King is here! Oh, and someone new!

dialogues.speaker: Hyakujitsuhaku Shion
dialogues.text: Hello. I'm Hyakujitsuhaku Shion. I'm a Yumekui-Baku like Kohaku here — or the Dough King, as most people know her. She told us about what happened.

dialogues.speaker: Hyakujitsuhaku Shion
dialogues.text: #Oh, {NICKNAME} and Paimon? I didn't know you'd be here too. I hope you've been well.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Shion! What a coincidence! We were gonna head to Aisa Bathhouse, but something came up and we had to change our plans.

dialogues.speaker: Hyakujitsuhaku Shion
dialogues.text: Ah, well, you're welcome any time. Mizuki is away on business, so I'm in charge in the meantime. It's, uh... quite the task, but I'm trying my best.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sounds like you're here for the same incident as us, then, hehe! Wow, small world!

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: So the Dough King is a Yumekui-Baku...

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: I read about them in "Little-Known Creatures of Teyvat: Inazuma Edition." Cute in appearance, with soft, dough-like bodies. Some can even take human form...

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: A friendly and approachable type of youkai, Yumekui-Baku help humans regulate their emotions by devouring nightmares.

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: That's all on page 136, if you were wondering.

dialogues.speaker: Hyakujitsuhaku Shion
dialogues.text: That was quite the knowledgeable introduction. We appreciate all the help so far, little ones.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Little witches! We're the Little Hexenzirkel!

dialogues.speaker: Hyakujitsuhaku Shion
dialogues.text: Oh, um... noted. Thank you, Little Hexenzirkel.

dialogues.speaker: Hyakujitsuhaku Shion
dialogues.text: As for our friend Popcorn... We discussed the situation with the baku that patrol the wilderness last night, and well... The situation is a bit complicated...

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Klee, why don't you and the other little witches go play with Popcorn for a bit?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Okay! Follow me, everyone!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Did you send them away on purpose?

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Well, our baku friend here did make it sound kind of serious...

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: It's not good for kids to be exposed to the dark side of the world too early, so I thought it was better to be safe.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You could stand to take your own advice...

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: I heard that! You just have to blurt out whatever pops into your head...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's because you care about them, huh, Prune?

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Ahem, well, they would've got impatient and run off to play sooner or later. I just... hurried things along.

dialogues.speaker: Hyakujitsuhaku Shion
dialogues.text: Haha, I'm not sure it's quite as serious as that, but allow me to explain.

dialogues.speaker: Hyakujitsuhaku Shion
dialogues.text: After Kohaku sent Popcorn off with the ki— Ahem... Or, um, the little witches, she found this in the area.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, this is giving Paimon the creeps... What is it?

dialogues.speaker: Hyakujitsuhaku Shion
dialogues.text: It's a nightmare fragment, formed from an accumulation of negative emotions.

dialogues.speaker: Hyakujitsuhaku Shion
dialogues.text: You can think of it as... emotions materialized in physical form. Popcorn happens to bear an identical signature to this fragment.

dialogues.speaker: Hyakujitsuhaku Shion
dialogues.text: We think he must have come into contact with it and undergone a similar process of materialization.

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Wait, so that must be why we can see him in the real world!

dialogues.speaker: Hyakujitsuhaku Shion
dialogues.text: Exactly. Imaginary friends are, at their essence, a harmless collection of positive emotions originating from the subconscious. But under the influence of the nightmare fragment, Popcorn is much less stable...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, he's definitely been pretty hot and cold, and his memories are all messed up!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! We tried to ask him about his human during the little witch's tea party. He said Homura is hurt and needs help!

response.speaker: Hyakujitsuhaku Shion
response.text: Based on what we know so far, it's possible Homura had a nightmare, which in turn affected Popcorn, and... that's how things turned out like this.

response.speaker: Prune
response.text: The Yumekui-Baku have a way to fix this, though, right? You deal with dreams all the time!

response.speaker: Prune
response.text: We have to help Popcorn! His human must be worried sick!

response.speaker: Hyakujitsuhaku Shion
response.text: Of course. In our experience, once a baku consumes these negative emotions, the affected parties should return to normal. That includes Popcorn and the human suffering from the nightmares.

response.speaker: Hyakujitsuhaku Shion
response.text: We were going to do just that. But then we received word that there are three other locations with a similar signature. Here, take a look.

response.speaker: Prune
response.text: That means there are three more of these nightmare fragments?

response.speaker: Hyakujitsuhaku Shion
response.text: Yes. The emotions contained within are highly volatile. Devouring this one right now could make the others even more unstable...

response.speaker: Hyakujitsuhaku Shion
response.text: It would be safer to retrieve them and devour all of them at once.

response.speaker: Hyakujitsuhaku Shion
response.text: That's not quite where our talents as baku lie though. With our round bodies, short legs, and stubby hands, we can't run fast or hold tools...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Just leave it to us!

response.speaker: Hyakujitsuhaku Shion
response.text: Really? I can't thank you enough! Here, take this map with you.

response.speaker: Hyakujitsuhaku Shion
response.text: Oh, be warned, though, the negative energy within the nightmare fragments might affect the surrounding environment.

response.speaker: Hyakujitsuhaku Shion
response.text: So pay close attention, and if you notice anything unusual, a nightmare fragment could be close.

response.speaker: Hyakujitsuhaku Shion
response.text: I'll gather a few other baku, and we'll be back tomorrow with empty stomachs and the materials needed to prep the nightmare for consumption.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, you need to prep it? You can't just... dig in?

response.speaker: Hyakujitsuhaku Shion
response.text: Uhh, it's nothing special, just a bit of... seasoning. Nightmares don't taste that great, so the seasoning helps them go down easier...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ohhh. Yeah... That sounds rough.

response.speaker: Hyakujitsuhaku Shion
response.text: It's what we do. Alright, I better get back to work. Kohaku will look after Popcorn in the meantime. See you tomorrow, and best of luck!

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: So, when are we doing this thing?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa!? When did you get here? Paimon didn't hear a thing!

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: Hehe, I wouldn't be a very good ninja if I didn't know how to move around without making noise. How else would I sneak off to go take a nap?

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: I even learned a new ninjutsu to help! Hidden mujina no jutsu!

response.speaker: Klee & Yaoyao
response.text: Tada!

response.speaker: Qiqi
response.text: ...Tada.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: So, um... we heard all of that! So what's the plan? When are we heading out?

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Yeah, Popcorn is our friend. We want to do our part to help him.

response.speaker: Prune
response.text: C'mon, we can't be bringing this many kids along. There's just too much to worry about.

response.speaker: Prune
response.text: I'm... not a kid!

response.speaker: Prune
response.text: (Whatever. You can learn a lot about someone by traveling together... Might be my chance to find out about the witches' weaknesses...)

response.speaker: Prune
response.text: Alright then... Let's gather our things and get a move on.

choices.text: Plus, we have a reliable kid like you to help out.
What about the human Popcorn belongs to?

talks.objective: Make ready and then set out

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm good to go.

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Based on the map our baku friend gave us, the closest fragment should be... Chinju Forest! Let's go!

talks.objective: Make ready and then set out

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright, this is the last location. Where should we start looking...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? A group of monsters? Well, that seems a bit obvious...

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: It's just a few Slimes. I'll deal with them.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: C'mon, little witches! Let's give Prune a hand!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Good luck! Paimon'll cheer you on from the sidelines!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And don't think that's Paimon being unhelpful! We've been through tons of tough battles, and cheering people on is always super important!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #You could even say it's the key to victory! Right, {NICKNAME}?

choices.text: Of course! This looks like it could be a fierce battle!
I'll supervise! You got this, everyone!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This little grove is the place marked on the map, right?

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Yeah, I know this place. I've slept in every single tree here. It used to be number five on my list of best napping spots.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Used to be?

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: It dropped to seventh after one of the shrine maidens found me.

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Alright, let's split up and look around. It'll be more efficient.

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: I'm a pretty good climber, so I can search one of the trees. Sayu can take another, and the rest—

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: C'mon, Prune, let's race! We'll start from here and see who can find the clues the fastest!

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Wait, I wasn't done talki—

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Come on, come on! It'll be good to stretch those muscles!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: #Count us down, okay, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: On your marks...

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Stick close to me, Qiqi!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Paimon, carry me!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... Paimon's not so sure about that...

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Whew... I've got this. The Yoohoo Art mad dash technique has never failed me.

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Who says I have to go along with this craziness...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Get set... Go!

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Charge!

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: That's it. I can't lose to some kid.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Huh? What are you still standing there for? We're falling behind! Here, grab onto me.

talks.objective: Find the nightmare fragment in the small forested area

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Man, this tree is kinda tough to climb. Good thing I got plenty of experience climbing roofs in Nod-Krai. Never thought that'd come in handy here...

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: The Baku said to look for things that seem off or out of place... Let's see...

talks.objective: Find the nightmare fragment in the small forested area

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: All that running was pretty tiring, huh, Qiqi. We can take a little break if you want.

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: Qiqi isn't tired. You're sweating, Yaoyao. Here, Qiqi will wipe it off.

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: Dr. Baizhu says sweating makes it easy to catch a cold. Gotta get dry fast.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: You remembered all that? Oh, make way for Bubu Pharmacy's little helper, people!

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: No, it was in my notes, right next to... "Find nitemair fragmints."

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Oh, um, that spelling is a bit... You know what? We'll fix that later. Let's focus on the fragments. Gotta put our herb-picking and radish-harvesting skills to good use!

talks.objective: Find the nightmare fragment in the small forested area

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Gonna blow them aaaalll up!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Put on the brakes there, Klee. "Mondstadt be bombed, Klee be doomed," remember?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: But, we're not in Mondstadt...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Which means it's even more important to follow the rules, right? If you wanna keep going on adventures, you need to show the Knights how well-behaved you are even when they're not around!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: I can be well-behaved! I wanna go on aaalll the adventures with the little witches!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then how about you search around the bottom of the tree, and Paimon will fly to the top and have a look.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Okay! Be careful, Paimon! I'll be careful, too!

talks.objective: Find the nightmare fragment in the small forested area

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Ahh... This spot is as comfortable as ever. Makes me super... sleepy... No, wake up!

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Right, I brought mint! That'll help me wake up. The sooner we find these fragments, the sooner I can sleep.

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Man, this tree is kinda tough to climb. Good thing I got plenty of experience climbing roofs in Nod-Krai. Never thought that'd come in handy here...

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: The Baku said to look for things that seem off or out of place... Let's see...

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Huh?! A giant tail? That can't be right!
Meeoww!?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Prune yanks the tail, eliciting a pained yelp... Everyone takes notice and gathers around.

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: That hurt...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Kirara?

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}! Paimon! Huh, seeing you, I feel much more awake! Oh, and who are these kids? Friends of yours, I'm guessing? Nice to meet you!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Hello, Miss Cat Lady! We're little witches!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What brings you here, Kirara?

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: Oh, it was a pretty light day delivery-wise, so I came here to sharpen my claws. Must have dozed off at some point, and then someone yanked my tail...

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: S—Sorry about that. It kinda seemed like something we were searching for...

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: You're a nekomata, right? That was in the Little-Known Creatures of Inazuma too. On page, um...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, you remember the page number for this one too?

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: (Shoot, I forgot. Ah, don't look at me like that...)

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Ahem, anyway... I could give you a ball of yarn to make it up to you?

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: Ooh, yarn? Ahem, uh... No need! You just startled me, that's all. It's not a big deal.

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: But you sure know a lot, huh, kid?

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: I'm not a— *sigh* Never mind.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Have you noticed anything strange around here, Kirara?

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: Huh, well... I usually like to nap under that tree over there. But for some reason, it felt off today, so I decided to sleep in this tree instead.

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Alright. You guys can keep chatting. I'll go check it out!

talks.objective: Talk to Prune and check on the situation
Talk to Prune and check on the situation

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yeah, let's go.

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Alright. The next location is to the east of Konda Village... I've got it memorized, so let's move!

talks.objective: Talk to Prune and go to the next location

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, your teamwork was amazing! You came in like "whoosh," and then went all "bam bam" and then "kerpow"! The monsters didn't stand a chance!

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Hehe... You weren't bad either, Paimon. Your voice was nice and... loud. Impressive fighting, everyone.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Hehe, little witches are just awesome like that!

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: That tuckered me out...

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: Hm, hungry.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Auntie Cloud Retainer said it's not good to wander around in the wild after dark. This is the last fragment, right? Let's pick it up and head back.

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Alright. After last time, we're all clear on what we need to do, right?

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Let's split up and investigate the area. If you find something, just give a shout, okay? All clear?

dialogues.speaker: #Klee & Yaoyao & Sayu & Paimon & {NICKNAME}
dialogues.text: Yes, ma'am!

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: ...Yes, ma'am!

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: #I—I didn't mean to make it sound like I was bossing you around, {NICKNAME}... Ahem, well, dismissed!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Man, I can't find them anywhere. Who would've thought these little Lavender Melons would be tougher to spot than an Onikabuto!

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: You can't see me. You can't see me.

talks.objective: Check on the little witches' new discovery

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Honorary Knight, Paimon, Prune! Over here!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Find something?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Yeah, something huge! A bunch of bugs in a line! I've never seen something like this before!

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: Me neither. Wow...

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Oh, these are Onikabuto. They're all over Inazuma.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: In Master's garden, I saw ants do something like this before. But, if they're moving to a new home, why aren't they carrying anything?

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Strange. Onikabuto are typically nocturnal creatures. During the day, they usually hide in cool, shady places like bushes or between rocks to avoid predators.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: You sure know a lot, Prune!

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Ahem. Their diet consists of tree sap and wild fruit. Given that they're nocturnal, you have a higher chance of encountering them at night.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You learn something new every day, huh!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: You can say that again!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Bull-chucker? What are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: We meet again, Lavender Melon! Hey, I'm out here lookin' for an Onikabuto upgrade. Bigger, stronger... You know the deal. Never stop the grind, am I right? What about you?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa, wait a second. We've got ourselves a whole patch of little Lavender Melons here. Ah, I know!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: You must be out here playing make-believe, huh? Hahaha! Well, I happen to be free as a bird. Want me to join?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Yeah! You can play a mean, old Demon King with great, big horns!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Old, huh... You sure about that?

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Quick, everyone, hide! Cover your heads! If he gives you a noogie, you'll never get taller!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You guys run! Paimon'll hold him off. Listen here, bull-chucker. You wanna get to them, you'll have to go through Paimon first!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hahahaha, Flying Lavender Melon's got a feisty side, huh. Well, guess you'll just have to be the first victim! Uh-oh, noogie incoming!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmph! Then, little witch Paimon curses you to lose 10,000 Mora every time you give a noogie!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hahahahaha! Good thing I'm sittin' pretty with nothing but a cool 500 Mora in my pocket!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Shoot, wrong strategy. Run!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Whoa, slow down there, little Lavender Melons, or you're gonna trip. You know what? 'Cause I'm cool like that, I'll give you a ten-second head start...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: One... two... three four five six seven eight nine ten! Hahaha!

choices.text: Kids will be kids, am I right?

response.speaker: Prune
response.text: Wait, I know!

response.speaker: Prune
response.text: The weird behavior of the Onikabuto is a clue! They would never venture out during the day... unless something happened to their original habitat.

response.speaker: Prune
response.text: In other words, we just need to follow their migration back to the source...

response.speaker: Prune
response.text: Yep, it's here! C'mon, let's pick it up.

response.speaker: Prune
response.text: That just leaves one more. We're so close!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: All thanks to you once again, Prune.

response.speaker: Prune
response.text: Please... The little witches were the ones who noticed the Onikabuto. They deserve the credit.

response.speaker: Prune
response.text: Only kids are obsessed with bugs like that. I doubt I would've even spotted them...

choices.text: So, looking at the world from a child's perspective...

response.speaker: Prune
response.text: Th—That's not the point! We have a job to finish. Let's call everyone back. We should head to the next location.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You've gotten used to working with them, huh.

response.speaker: Prune
response.text: Well, we can't just leave them here with that oni. He doesn't exactly strike me as a responsible adult.

choices.text: Alright, I'll call them back, and then we'll head out!

response.speaker: Prune
response.text: Let's see... Our last stop is the beach north of Konda Village. Time to go!

choices.text: Let's let the kids finish playing first. I'll keep an eye on them.
Might not be such a bad idea.
Our oni friend also happens to be a kid at heart.

talks.objective: Talk to Prune and check on the situation
Talk to Prune and check on the situation

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I think we're ready to set out!

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Let's see... Our last stop is the beach north of Konda Village. Time to go!

talks.objective: Talk to Prune and go to the next location

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Popcorn, Dough King, we're back!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa... Look at all this food! Did you guys do this for us?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You discuss the day's events over a delicious meal. Collecting the nightmare fragments went smoother than expected and was a lot more fun. Perhaps it's just the effect of all the little witches being together.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Popcorn, we spoke to the Dough King, and we're gonna get you back to normal tomorrow!

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Yeah, and once Homura's nightmare gets eaten, she'll get better too!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Then we'll help Popcorn find Homura, and we can all play together!

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: Wish all our imaginary friends could come out and play too.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Oooh, Mom's magic can do that!

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Have you learned that one yet, Klee?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Um, no... All I know is the introduction magic for the little witches...

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Huh, I bet Master, Auntie Cloud Retainer, and Uncle Mountain Shaper could do it! They all have those super impressive adepti abilities.

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: My sensei definitely could too! A great ninja can do anything!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Oh! Um... What about you, {NICKNAME}? Could you do something like that?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not a chance!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah. Guess Paimon has a lot to learn from the other little witches, huh!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, all the imaginary friends hanging out together... Just thinking about it is interesting!

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: Uh... Does Paimon have one too?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Nope, but Paimon already has someone to keep her company, someone she can talk to no matter what... {NICKNAME}!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What about you, Prune? Do you have an imaginary friend?

response.speaker: Prune
response.text: Of course! He's my best friend. His name is Descartes. He's a puppy, and he's super adorable.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Just like you!

response.speaker: Prune
response.text: Um, I guess if you think I'm cute, then... sure.

response.speaker: Prune
response.text: Ahem, well, we're just about done here, right? We should all get some rest. I'll walk you back.

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: You should stay with us, Prune. The shrine maiden lady got us a huge room. We've been staying there together these past few days, and there's more than enough space.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Yeah! We even had a pillow fight last night!

response.speaker: Prune
response.text: Um, well, I already have my own accommodations, so...

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: C'mon, Prune! Play with us! Pretty please!

response.speaker: Prune
response.text: ...Fine. Let's go.

choices.text: Paimon is the best travel buddy I could ask for!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: I'm gonna bring a whole bunch of bombs. If we run into meanies on the road, I'll blast 'em straight to space!

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: I have an umbrella in case it rains or gets too sunny. Oh, and I prepared some herbal insect repellent for everyone. Should come in handy!

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: #Here, put this in your pocket, and you won't have to worry about bug bites out in the wild. I have some for Prune and {NICKNAME} too.

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: If you fall, don't cry. Come find Qiqi. Qiqi will help apply a cold compress...

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Oh, and the roads in Inazuma are kinda complicated. Make sure to stick together, and don't go wandering off alone. If you do get lost, just stay where you are, and I'll come find you.

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: #We should look out for Prune and {NICKNAME} too. The Little Hexenzirkel needs to keep them safe!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Yeah! {NICKNAME}'s always the one protecting other people. It's about time we flipped the script!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, and in case we need an energy boost when we're out in the wild, Paimon prepped a bunch of tasty snacks we can eat on the go without getting too messy. So, if anyone gets hungry, just let Paimon know!

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Alright, I'm ready to head out whenever.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I just need a sec.

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Miss Nekomata, can you recommend some other good napping spots?

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: Umm, well... a cardboard box is always good, or a grandmother's lap...

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Miss Cat Lady, I know another cat person, but she only has one tail. Is she gonna get another when she grows up?

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: Um, I doubt it... unless she's also a youkai from the nekomata clan.

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: What's the difference between a youkai and a yaoxie?

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: Uh... What's a yaoxie?

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Oh, it's a kind of evil monster. Y'know, Qiqi, I bet it's like the difference between a good youkai and a bad youkai. Just like how there are good people and bad people.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's right! Kirara's a super nice youkai, just like the Dough King.

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Yep, looks like there is a nightmare fragment here!

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Let's store it for now. We should press on to the next location.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yeah, let's go.

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Alright. The next location is to the east of Konda Village... I've got it memorized, so let's move!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Better to take our time. Let's rest for a bit before we go.

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: We should press on to the next location.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Better to take our time. Let's rest for a bit before we go.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: If that mean Demon King with horns finds us, I'm gonna blow him up!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's not get ahead of ourselves... He's not that bad.

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: Qiqi doesn't care about getting taller. Yaoyao can stand behind me. Qiqi will protect.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Nuh uh! We're both gonna get taller! That's a promise!

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: After watching them for a while, honestly, that oni guy seems like the biggest kid of them all. All that height's just for show, huh...

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Seriously, all he has to do to find them is get some high ground... Ahem, not that I'm invested in this game. Just find me when we're ready to go. In the meantime, I'm gonna do some reading.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Might as well let them play a bit longer.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Find something, Dodoco?

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Nothing here. Let's go look over there!

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: Okay.

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: C'mon, Sayu. Gotta stay awake...

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Nothing strange as far as I can tell...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You can do it!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That was amazing!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: An overwhelming advantage!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Perfect teamwork!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Uh... Nope.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Nothing here either. Would be real nice if we could just blow the ground up and see...

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: No, no, no. Klee's a good girl... Klee's a good girl...

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Nothing here, too...

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: But I won't give up! Let's goooo!

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: A fragment. I found it. A fragment.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Really? Let me see!

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: Will a stone fragment do?

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Not exactly. Let's go over there and have a look!

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: What is it?

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: The grass here. I'd like to pick some. For Dr. Baizhu.

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: We might be able to make herbal medicines from it.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: That makes sense. Put it in my basket, then!

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: Done. Let's go.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Nothing here... But don't worry. We'll find it!

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: Is it heavy, Yaoyao?

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: Let me carry the pack for you.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Thanks, Qiqi, but it's not heavy. I can carry it just fine.

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: So sleepy... No, I can't! I've gotta help out!

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Let's get the blood pumping first. That should wake us up a bit.

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Let's analyze the geography first.

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Oh, great. I can't get anything at all...

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Wait, wait, wait! Sayu, my eyes are glazing over...

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Hah! All better now!

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Have you found anything yet?

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Ahem! N—Not yet... Let's look for it together, shall we?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Klee will help!

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: Looking for fragments...

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Stick close, Qiqi.

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Wouldn't we find nightmare fragments in dreams?

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Something's gotta be off here...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oooh, Mora! Quick, pick it up!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, it's just a Lavender Melon...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Go, Klee, go! Use Jumpy Dumpty!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Go full ninja, Sayu! Get 'em, Yuegui!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Nice one, Qiqi! Everyone's back in fighting form!

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: (I didn't expect them to be so strong... Gotta figure out the right counter strategy.)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's the spirit, Prune! Get 'em!
